title: Malaysia-tagged green sea turtle rescued in Bohol

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — A female green sea turtle tagged in Sabah, Malaysia, was rescued after it was found struggling to return to the sea off Pangangan Island in Calape town, Bohol, on Wednesday, Nov. 4.
